title: Suntit Is Calling
description: This project was made while I was under the influence of insanity. It's about "suntits" which are sun-shaped things that have smiley faces on them.
body:
This datapack is very insane. All things related to Suntit will be developed here. Prepare to become insane. For now, I have added the sunstick.

Sunstick:
- Left click: Send mobs/players to the sun.
- Right click: Get called by Suntit.
